game.title: KEPPER: Code Islands
game.subtitle: Build a program and watch KEPPER bring it to life across floating islands.

1.title: First steps
1.description: Guide KEPPER to the glowing portal.
1.hint: The starter already moves once. Add two more Move commands.

2.title: The bend
2.description: Take the turn and reach the portal. Repeat can save you from writing Move again and again.
2.hint: Move twice, turn right, then move twice more.

3.title: Find the bug
3.description: The starter program has wrong turns. Fix it so KEPPER reaches the portal.
3.hint: After the first Move, the path turns right, then left, then right again.

4.title: Two possible roads
4.description: One program must win on both maps. Check whether the tile ahead is blocked.
4.hint: The clear road runs east. On the blocked map, go north first, then east along the upper path.

5.title: Crystal crossing
5.description: Collect all three crystals on both maps. One route is straight; the other winds around the blocked section.
5.hint: Use If blocked to choose the opening route. Rejoin the main road, collect its remaining crystals, then turn toward the goal.

6.title: Open the gate
6.description: The switch is above the road on one map and below it on the other. Open the gate before crossing to the crystal and goal.
6.hint: Move two tiles and face north. If that tile is blocked, the switch must be south. Return facing east after pressing it.

7.title: Paired portals
7.description: Cross a fragile path, adapt to two possible exits, then use a second portal to reach the final crystal trail.
7.hint: After the first portal, test the tile ahead. Rejoin the road before the second portal; the final trail bends twice.

8.title: Across the gap
8.description: One program must clear three maps: moving crystals, gaps, and a solid crossing. Collect every crystal on the long return path.
8.hint: Check the first tile and the middle crossing. After the belt, trace the crystal trail down, across, and back toward the goal.

9.title: Read the road
9.description: Four maps change crystal positions along six broken sections. Sense the road repeatedly and loop around the outer island.
9.hint: Repeat one sensor pattern at the start, then three more times around the outer loop. The fragile entry prevents going back.

10.title: The last crossing
10.description: Four maps, two islands, two gates, and shifting crystals. Reach the second portal, cross the conveyor island, and gather every crystal.
10.hint: Open the first gate before teleporting. On the second island, sense both crystal crossings, use the conveyor, and finish along the southern edge.

game.codeHelp: move, left, right, jump, repeat 2 { … }, if blocked { … } else { … }, if crystal ahead { … } else { … }
game.runTip: Press Run to test every map. Ctrl+Enter also works.
